```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*.*.*"

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  ci:
    name: CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-features

      - name: Run security audit
        run: cargo audit

  release:
    name: Release
    needs: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: crates.io
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Install musl-tools
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools

      - name: Install cross
        run: cargo install cross

      - name: Build binaries
        run: |
          cross build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --release
          cross build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --release
          cross build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --release
          cross build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --release
          cross build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --release
          cross build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --release

      - name: Create release archive
        run: |
          mkdir -p release
          tar -czf release/keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz -C target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release keifu
          tar -czf release/keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz -C target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release keifu
          tar -czf release/keifu-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz -C target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release keifu
          tar -czf release/keifu-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz -C target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release keifu
          tar -czf release/keifu-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz -C target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release keifu
          zip -j release/keifu-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/keifu.exe

      - name: Generate changelog
        uses: orhun/git-cliff-action@v3
        with:
          config: cliff.toml
          args: --tag ${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          body_path: CHANGELOG.md
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./release/keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./release/keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./release/keifu-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./release/keifu-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./release/keifu-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./release/keifu-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip
```
